# Test fixtures

Everything here is **synthetic** (written for this project) unless a row says otherwise. Never
add real meeting audio, transcripts, vault content or personal data. Audio fixtures follow
SPECIFICATION §15.5 Q4: clips of at most 60 s and 2 MB named `*.fixture.<ext>`, with source,
licence and speaker consent recorded below.

## `notes/` (Phase 03)
| File | Source | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `2026-10-11 - Product Sync.md` | Synthetic; generated by `tests/unit/test_golden.py` | Golden note: frontmatter, Appendix B header, four sections, AI Recommendations last |
| `2026-10-11 - Product Sync.transcript.md` | Synthetic; generated by `tests/unit/test_golden.py` | Golden companion transcript paired with the note (merged turns, an unmapped speaker, data block) |
| `user-edited.md` | Synthetic, hand-written | A note edited the way a user would in Obsidian: block-style lists, a frontmatter comment, a user property, a callout, text between sections, an edited heading, trailing text |
| `damaged-markers.md` | Synthetic, hand-written | A section whose closing marker was deleted (R11 error path) next to an intact section |

The names and people are invented. Regenerate the golden pair with
`MM3_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 uv run pytest tests/unit/test_golden.py` and review the diff; the format
itself is defined in `docs/dev-guide/note-format.md`.

## `search_vault/` (Phase 15i)
A small synthetic vault for the search tests: seven invented meetings (a note and a companion transcript each, under
`Meetings/2026/`), generated by `tests/search_corpus.py` with the app's own writers. One topic, money spent beyond
the plan, appears in three meetings in different words ("budget overrun", "spending more than planned", "costs
exceeded the forecast"); the Hiring Plan's AI Recommendations mention the budget, which must not be indexed.
People and companies are invented; CC0. Regenerate with
`MM3_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 uv run pytest tests/unit/search/test_corpus.py` and review the diff.

## Ask-AI corpus (Phase 15j, `tests/ask_corpus.py`, not a folder)
The seven search meetings plus a *Meeting Context* section stating people's roles in the three overspending
meetings, and an eighth decoy meeting (*Team Offsite Planning*) that mentions a budget without overspending it.
Written into a temporary vault by the Ask-AI tests, the Ask-AI browser test and `tests/eval/ask_eval.py`, which also holds
the six eval questions and their expected meetings and people. Invented people and numbers; CC0.

## `assembler/` (Phase 09)
| File | Source | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `<template-id>.txt` | Synthetic; generated by `tests/unit/templates/test_assembler.py` | Golden prompts per built-in template (system message, each section's tail, the shared context) for a fixed invented meeting |
| `default-notes-untimed.txt` | Synthetic; generated by `tests/unit/importing/test_untimed.py` (Phase 15k) | Default Notes prompts for an untimed imported conversation: no `[mm:ss]` stamps, no Length line, the "no timestamps" rule |

Regenerate with `MM3_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 uv run pytest tests/unit/templates/test_assembler.py` after an
intended prompt change and review the diff.

## `tests/eval/meetings/` (Phase 09)
Three synthetic meetings written for the generation eval (`launch-sync`, `cache-design-review`,
`budget-checkin`): invented people and companies, with the expected decisions, actions (and owners)
and open questions. CC0. See `tests/eval/run_eval.py`.

## `imports/` (Phase 15k)
Synthetic files written for the import parsers (CC0, invented people and topics; no real conversation is used):

| File | Shape | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `chatgpt-style.md` | `# Title`, `You said:` / `ChatGPT said:` turns, a numbered list with bold labels, a code fence with a `Label:` line inside, `Copy` and `2 / 2` chrome | `tests/unit/importing/test_parsers.py` |
| `claude-style.md` | `## Human` / `## Claude` headings, multi-line answers | parsers |
| `voice-mode-unlabelled.md` | Mimics a Grok voice-mode export: no labels or times, user speech with fillers and **growing prefixes**, multi-paragraph answers, a tool-status line, short turns on both sides, a `2 / 2` counter. `voice-mode-unlabelled.labels` is the ground truth (`U`/`A` per paragraph after prefix collapsing) | parsers (≥ 95 % role accuracy), import jobs, `tests/e2e/test_import_flow.py` |
| `timestamped.txt` | `[hh:mm:ss] Name: text` lines, one speaker continuing over two lines | parsers, import jobs |
| `grok-share-linear.json` | Phase 15l. A Grok share's JSON (same shape and keys as the real endpoint, invented content and ids): a voice-mode chat with growing human prefixes, Markdown and a code fence in answers, the generic title "Discussion Request". Written by hand for this phase (CC0) | `tests/unit/importing/test_grok_share.py`, `test_share_jobs.py`, `tests/e2e/test_import_flow.py` |
| `grok-share-branched.json` | Phase 15l. A regenerated answer and an edited question (two children of one parent each); the latest child must win | `test_grok_share.py` |
| `grok-share-partial.json` | Phase 15l. An empty message, a `partial` reply and an unknown `system` sender, all dropped | `test_grok_share.py` |
| `grok-share-unicode.json` | Phase 15l. French, Japanese, Arabic, Greek and an emoji | `test_grok_share.py` |
| `mm3-export.txt` | The MM3 `.txt` export layout: `mm:ss Name` (and `h:mm:ss Name`) then the text | parsers |
| `captions.vtt` | WebVTT with a header, a `NOTE`, `<v Name>` and `<v.class Name>` voice tags and a `Name:` prefix | parsers |
| `captions.srt` | SubRip with `Name:` prefixes, an `<i>` tag and a cue with no speaker | parsers |

The untimed golden prompt `assembler/default-notes-untimed.txt` is built in `tests/unit/importing/test_untimed.py`.

## `audio/` (Phase 06)
| File | Source | Licence | Speakers and consent | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ami-es2002a-two-speakers.fixture.opus` | [AMI Meeting Corpus](https://groups.inf.ed.ac.uk/ami/corpus/) meeting ES2002a, `ES2002a.Mix-Headset.wav`, seconds 500-560 (`ffmpeg -ss 500 -t 60 ... -ac 1 -ar 16000 -c:a libopus -b:a 32k -map_metadata -1`); 60 s, 187 KB, SHA-256 `046f19ac30685b2fe9df9613aa4a66167d7d6fb52ae612920720929e7d5b44c2` | CC-BY-4.0 (attribution: AMI Meeting Corpus, University of Edinburgh and the AMI Consortium) | Two participants (AMI speakers B and D, about 32 s of speech each per the AMI manual segment annotations; no other speaker in the window). Recorded by the AMI project with participant consent for publication under the corpus licence. | GPU acceptance test (`tests/integration/test_transcription_gpu.py`): at least 2 speakers, words "price" and "retail" |

Long and private recordings are never committed. The `slow` GPU test reads them from
`MM3_PRIVATE_TEST_AUDIO` (a file or a folder) and prints only numbers (duration, speed, speaker
count), never names or transcript text.
